name: Toonix
storyline:
Toonix is a game that allows children to visit the Cartoon Network and create their own Toonix character. No in-game purchases.
Create your very own Toonix by picking your favourite combination of eyes, mouth, cool costumes and head accessories to create your own Toonix avatar.And if you get bored with that look, just pick another one. There are MILLIONS of combinations and once you've made your very own, you can share it with friends or save it to your phone.There's also a Toonix waiting in your "cube"! You can tickle it, jump, spin it and do other fun things. See if you can find everything it can do.Want more? Create, play and explore more on Toonix.com
summary: A simple game designed for children that allows them to customize a Toonix character. They can then take care of it as if it were a pet, play with it, etc. Includes many customization options including choices for the eyes, mouth, hairstyle, clothing, and accessories. Children will have tons of fun playing with it. Take photos of your Toonix and then save them on your phone so that you'll be able to remember your funniest designs.
